mapper.select: select * from b_xiecheng_data where status =1 and push_status =1 and local_id = #{localId};
select local_id from b_xiecheng_data where status =1 and push_status =1 order by id asc limit 10000

select report.push_status as pushStatus from b_xiecheng_colliding_data_loop_cycle cycle inner join b_xiecheng_data report on cycle.cell_sha256_code_list = report.sha256_tel where report.sha256_tel = #{cell} and report.api_code = #{apiCode} and cycle.is_delete = 0 and cycle.push_time < report.create_time
